img.metadata: stripped by re-encoding the PNG so only pixel data remains
img.identity_views: two renders sharing the rule; neither depends on the label

graph3d.fallback: UFF if MMFF has no parameters for the molecule, recorded per molecule
graph3d.select: lowest energy among candidates that CONVERGED (converged flag 0)
graph3d.on_failure: no candidate converged even at max_iters_extended, or embedding produced nothing under both the declared rule and the random-coordinate fallback, or neither MMFF nor UFF covers the molecule -> the molecule is recorded as a conversion failure. It is never replaced, and no score of 0 is written for it.
graph3d.fallback_order: v1 rule first and unchanged; random-coordinate embedding only if nothing embedded; the extended iteration cap only if nothing converged. A molecule the v1 rule already expressed never reaches a fallback, so frozen v1 payloads are unaffected.
graph3d.stereo: includeStereo=False, so the chiral flag stays 0 and no wedge/hash bond is written: the export cannot add a stereochemical label the source structure did not carry. Reading a 3D block back makes RDKit PERCEIVE stereocentres, which is why the round-trip check compares the stereo-free constitution.
graph3d._project_choice: candidate count, seed, iteration cap, optimiser and fallback order are THIS project's choices, not a published standard

cml.coords: none (structure only, so it stays a text-format comparison)
cml.aromaticity: explicit Kekule bond orders plus an aromatic flag

moljson._atom_id_style_reason: MolToJSON's default style names an atom after its element and a running counter (C1, C2, ... O4). That spells out how many atoms of each element the molecule has, which IS the answer to the atom-count task, so it would hand one representation a free win. The sequential style (a1, a2, ...) is the same converter, the same schema and the same document shape, with ids that carry no element count. This is a fairness adjustment, not a change of schema.
moljson._include_empty_fields_reason: the schema lists charges and aromatic_n_h as required; the converter's default omits them when empty, so the payload would fail its own schema. Emitting them as null is the schema's declared representation of 'none'.

identity_views._rule: slot A uses view 0 and slot B uses view 1 for a positive pair AND for a negative pair, so the view a molecule is drawn in carries no information about the answer
identity_views._not_applied_to: the three inherited representations reuse their frozen main-02 responses, which were produced under the earlier construction (positives 0/1, negatives 0/0); that is recorded as a stimulus-design difference, not hidden
